# Hand-written sample of the Paradox script syntax
@local_cost = 250

sample_item = {
	cost = @local_cost         # local variable
	global_cost = @tier1cost1  # common/scripted_variables
	derived = @derived
	maths = @[ local_cost * 2 + tier1weight1 / 4 ]
	brackets = @[ ( local_cost - 50 ) * @half ]
	name = "Quoted # not a comment"
	number_string = "10"
	enabled = yes
	disabled = no
	negative = -3
	decimal = 0.25
	category = { computing "voidcraft" }
	color = rgb { 255 128 0 }
	map_color = hsv { 0.5 0.25 1.0 }
	potential = {
		num_pops >= 10
		has_monthly_income < 5
		years_passed > 20
		tier <= 3
		value != 2
		other == 4
		maybe ?= yes
		NOT = { has_flag = no_flag }
	}
	modifier = { factor = 2 }
	modifier = { factor = 0.5 }
	list_of_blocks = { { a = 1 } { a = 2 } }
	date = 2200.01.01
	scope:target = value:some_value|PARAM|1|
}

second_item = {
	inline_script = {
		script = test/upkeep
		RESOURCE = minerals
		AMOUNT = 3
	}
	inline_script = { script = test/nested AMOUNT = 2 }
	inline_script = {
		script = test/statements
		STATEMENTS = "alpha = 1 beta = { 2 3 }"
	}
	inline_script = {
		script = test/statements
		STATEMENTS = "owner? = {
			has_country_flag = multi_line
		}"
	}
	unknown = @not_defined
}
